title: Abaddon's Abysmal Candy
description: Abaddon's Abysmal Candy — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 25 of Abaddon's Abysmal Candy from The Embercore Path

Quest Reward: 10000 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Wally Wanka

Repeatable: Unknown

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 25 of Abaddon's Abysmal Candy from within The Embercore Path and Return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

I just have to get my hands on some of this Abysmal Candy that Abaddon has been cooking up in The Embercore Path. His candy has been getting rave reviews from the people of Townston even though it is supposed to be targeted for monsters. How does one target candy for monsters? Did Abaddon get a focus group of monsters together to taste different candies? Did he do extensive Market Research? Did he launch an all-encompassing Dungeon Survey to determine what candy monsters like the most? Did he send a chat message that he was looking for focus group?

Well, no matter, the fact remains that Abaddon has created a popular line of candy and I wouldn't be doing my job if I didn't at least taste it. I have no interest in getting into the monster candy business, but there might be something to it. Can you get into The Embercore Path and gather up some of Abaddon's Abysmal Candy for me? When you have a sampling of his candies return to me, Wally Wanka, here in The Embercore Portal.

Turn-in:

Hmmm...these candies are sort of odd-shaped and they smell like sweat. Here is your reward for getting me the candies.

Objectives:

  • Abaddon's Abysmal Candy ×25

Level range: 40–100
